$comment: Hand-edited source of truth. IA.md and matrix.csv are generated by build.mjs. Section order per template is taken from src/pages/*.jsx; implementedBy paths are relative to src/. Descriptions describe structure and behaviour only, never page copy.

meta.source: Local replica of teachable.com (homepage + 17 main-nav pages), React + Vite clone at /src
meta.generatedBy: ia-builder skill, derived from src/routes.js, src/App.jsx and src/pages/*.jsx

categories.SHELL: Chrome rendered by the shared layout around every route: navigation, promo strip, footer.
categories.CAMPAIGN: Time-limited promotional blocks that sit above a page's hero.
categories.HERO: The page-opening block that clears the navigation.
categories.PROOF: Social proof and credibility: stats, stories, testimonials, logos, ratings, badges.
categories.FEATURES: Product explanation: capability rows, card grids, sliders, scroll scenes and directories.
categories.OFFERING: What is for sale and at what price: product-type cards, plan cards, comparison and fees.
categories.CONVERSION: Blocks whose job is a sign-up, contact or demo action: CTA cards, forms, modals.
categories.SUPPORT: Help and further reading: FAQ accordions and resource/article cards.

shell.promo-marquee.description: Thin full-width strip above the nav with a continuously scrolling row of promo links (25s CSS loop, pauses on hover).

shell.navbar-sticky.description: Black navigation bar in sticky mode: logo, Products/Resources click-open mega-dropdowns whose panel top moves from 8rem to 4.8rem after 150px of scroll, login/sign-up actions, hamburger overlay at 1145px and below.

shell.navbar-fixed.description: The same navigation bar in fixed mode: pinned to the viewport top over the content, dropdown panel top constant at 5rem; the first section clears it with hero-top padding.

shell.footer.description: Black footer: four link columns, social icons, compliance badge, oversized logo with three echo layers that follow the pointer, copyright row.

campaign.halloween-banner.description: Seasonal campaign card with a live countdown to 31 Oct 2026 and a close button; time-limited, reuses one component with a larger top-padding variant on product pages.
campaign.halloween-banner.scope: Homepage plus four product pages; 5 routes.

hero.home-tabs.description: Homepage hero: h1, two pill buttons, two product tabs that autoplay every 6s with a progress bar, and floating UI panels animating in per tab.

hero.product.description: Product-page hero: tag, h1 (glyph letters allowed), paragraph, one or two buttons, large product image; optional gold image backdrop.
hero.product.scope: The four product pages plus customer-journey; 5 routes.

hero.feature.description: Feature-page hero: two columns at 0.5fr/1fr with the image first, tag, h1 that may swap a letter for a glyph, paragraph, button and optional login line.
hero.feature.scope: Five feature pages plus ai-hub and app-hub; 7 routes.

hero.split.description: Split hero in dark-olive or light tone: copy and buttons on one side, video iframe or image on the other, optional logo marquee strip underneath.

hero.text-only.description: Centred text-only hero: a single large h1 with no image or buttons.

hero.demo-unlock.description: Gated demo hero: email pill with the submit button inside it, consent checkbox, blurred video frame that unlocks to an autoplaying video and a slide-in offer banner; remembers unlocked visitors; no real submission.

proof.stats-row.description: Homepage stats row: three large figures with labels separated by vertical dividers.

proof.stats-marquee.description: Single-line marquee of stat chips with icons scrolling on a 60s linear loop; hidden at 479px and below where the stacked stats take over.
proof.stats-marquee.scope: Three product pages plus ai-hub; 4 routes.

proof.stats-stack.description: Mobile-only vertical stack of stat blocks that replaces the stats marquee at 479px and below.
proof.stats-stack.scope: Three product pages plus ai-hub; 4 routes.

proof.stories-carousel.description: Creator success-stories carousel: six slides, 2s autoplay loop, prev/next buttons, pauses on hover; site-builder uses its centred-slides auto-height option.
proof.stories-carousel.scope: Homepage, four product pages, five feature pages, ai-hub and pricing; 12 routes.

proof.case-study-slider.description: Two-column case-study block: intro on the left, looping slider of three case cards with an 'n / 3' counter on the right.

proof.video-review.description: Video testimonial: thumbnail with play button that opens a lightbox player, next to a quote and attribution.

proof.testimonial-slider.description: Non-looping testimonial slider with arrows that hide at each end, dots and drag-swipe.

proof.quote-banner.description: Diagonal lemon-to-grey band with a company wordmark on the left and a large quote with attribution on the right.

proof.security-badges.description: Row of four security/compliance badge cards under a heading.

proof.logo-marquee.description: Section with a heading, text and button above two rows of payment-method logo tiles scrolling in opposite directions (24s), each row pausing on hover.

proof.logo-row.description: Static row of five customer logos under a short line of text.

proof.rating.description: Grey band with an app-store rating heading and star-rated review cards, three columns collapsing to two and then one.

features.demo-cta.description: Single centred 'Explore demo' button block directly under the homepage stats.

features.why-scroll.description: Pinned 280vh scroll scene: a card grows out of the corner, its heading resizes and the blue backdrop and photo zoom, all scroll-scrubbed; not sticky below 992px.

features.why-cards.description: Three alternating image/text rows pulled up over the preceding scroll scene by 17vh.

features.feature-rows.description: Alternating image/text rows with an optional header and no overlap with the section above.
features.feature-rows.scope: Payments only, used twice on the page; 1 route.

features.scale-slider.description: Global-scale scene: sticky three-step slider with a progress bar, flag badges that burst out and drift, a cycling translated word; replaced by a stacked layout with sliding flag rows at 767px and below.

features.ai-automations.description: AI section: heading with a shimmer gradient and three image cards whose titles underline on hover.

features.integrations-hub.description: Integrations grid: 18 app logos on a ruled grid that scale in with a scroll-scrubbed stagger, hover tooltips, and a button to the app directory.
features.integrations-hub.scope: Homepage plus four product pages; 5 routes.

features.feature-split.description: Grey or white panel with a header and rows of image/text pairs that alternate the image side.
features.feature-split.scope: Online-courses, coaching and digital-downloads, used one to three times per page; 3 routes.

features.stagger-cards.description: Three cards offset vertically by 6rem / 0 / 3rem, in a platform or spotlight skin.

features.steps.description: Numbered step cards whose backgrounds pulse in sequence (4s loop, 0.2s stagger).

features.tier-cards.description: Anchored programme-tier cards with badges, bullet lists and tinted backgrounds that pulse in turn (6s, delays 0 / 1.5 / 3s).

features.why-band.description: Yellow or gold band with a very large heading and a right column holding an optional pill label or icon circle.
features.why-band.scope: Four feature pages plus customer-journey; 5 routes.

features.why-statement.description: Standalone 6rem statement heading block introducing the membership slider.

features.explainer.description: Optional centred header, then one to three image/text rows alternating sides, each with one or two title/paragraph pairs and an optional button.
features.explainer.scope: Five feature pages plus ai-hub; 6 routes.

features.card-list.description: Grid of four or eight grey feature cards, icons optional, that start staggered and flatten as you scroll (desktop only).

features.two-col.description: Two-column text/image block with a button; an 'int' variant keeps text first on mobile and uses a secondary button.

features.quick-links-slider.description: Looping slider of five link cards with images, controlled by a prev / 'n / N' / next pill.

features.tools-grid.description: Grid of tool cards that fade and slide up at 20% visibility, with dashed connector lines growing after 200ms; resets out of view and replays.

features.sell-list.description: Header plus an iconised list of sellable item types.

features.dyna-slider.description: Tabbed slider with 4s autoplay, progress bar, pause/play and prev/next; reproduces the original's empty-column loop quirk.

features.app-directory.description: Six category tabs (fade 100ms out / 300ms in) over a 3/2/1-column grid of 29 app cards with learn-more links, plus a footnote.

features.use-case-cards.description: Four image cards in the enterprise skin of the product-card grid, titles underlining on hover.

features.demo-embed.description: Interactive demo frame that expands and collapses with text and thumbnail fades; hidden at 991px and below.

features.work-cards.description: Three white icon cards on a warm background.

features.image-feature-grid.description: Full-width image followed by a 2x2 feature grid and a button.

features.video-feature.description: Feature block built around an embedded video.

features.compare-table.description: Two-column comparison table with check and cross icons.

features.examples-tabs.description: Six category pill tabs, each revealing five or six example cards; section height changes per tab.

offering.product-cards.description: Four product-type cards (4 then 2 then 1 columns) with a start-free button.

offering.pricing-teaser.description: Three-card pricing teaser: two plan cards and an enterprise card, linking to the full pricing page.

offering.plan-cards.description: Full plan cards with a Monthly/Yearly toggle (Yearly default) that swaps prices and strike-throughs with a fade.

offering.plan-comparison.description: Feature comparison matrix with eight filter pills (instant switch) and tooltips; becomes per-plan tabs at 991px and below.

offering.fee-dropdowns.description: Click-to-open fee dropdowns that push content down, with no animation.

conversion.payments-cta.description: Gradient card at 1.5fr/1fr with a tag, heading, arrow list and an arrow button whose icon rotates on hover.

conversion.cta-card.description: Coloured CTA card in a blue, red or black tone with a heading, optional paragraph, button and optional login line, and variable section padding.
conversion.cta-card.scope: Four product pages, customer-journey, five feature pages, ai-hub, app-hub, pricing and examples; 14 routes.

conversion.migrate-banner.description: Gradient split banner pairing a migration message with an image and button.

conversion.impact-cta.description: Full-bleed photo with a white heading and a primary button to pricing, closing the page.

conversion.sales-form.description: Contact-sales section: copy column and a static form card (progress bar, fields, consent, submit) that does not submit anywhere.

conversion.exit-modal.description: Exit-intent modal armed after 5s: locks scroll, closes on Esc, shown at most once per session.

support.faq.description: FAQ accordion: one item open at a time (first open on load), height animation and 135° icon rotation; answers may hold paragraphs, lists and links; optional footnote card.
support.faq.scope: Homepage, three product pages, customer-journey, mobile-app, site-builder, pricing and payments; 9 routes.

support.resource-cards.description: Resource or article cards, with or without images, whose titles underline and arrows rotate on hover.
support.resource-cards.scope: Coaching, memberships, analytics-and-reporting and ai-hub; 4 routes.
